summary: Priests are cloth-wearing healers and Shadow casters who shield and mend allies, dispel magic and punish enemies with Holy and Shadow spells. Their racial spells (Fear Ward, Chastise, Shadowguard, Starshards and others) depend on the priest's race.
talent_levels_note: A talent ability can be taken once you can reach its row: the first talent point comes at level 10 and each row needs 5 more points, so row N opens at level 10 + 5 × (N − 1). Talent rows are from wowforevertalent.com; the Forever tooltips of Holy Nova (20), Mind Flay (20) and Prayer of Mending (40) show the same levels as their rows.

abilities.summary: Heals the target of 45 damage over 15 sec.

This spell can only be placed on one target at a time per caster.

changes: New talent abilities: Penance (Discipline row 5) and Prayer of Mending (Holy row 7).
Shadow Word: Death is new and is trained at level 32, not a talent; Early Demise (Shadow row 6) improves it.
Divine Spirit is trained at level 30 instead of being a talent; Silence, Vampiric Embrace and Shadowform remain talents in rows 5, 4 and 7.
New racial priest spells: Chastise (Dwarf), Divine Grace (Human), Dark Sacrifice (Undead), Confounding Flash and Contingency Plan (Gnome).
Many spells (Smite, Heal, Flash Heal, Renew, Holy Fire and others) are marked Changed on wowforevertalent.com.
conflicts: Penance: wowforevertalent.com places it at row 5 (level 30), but the rank 1 tooltip says Requires level 40. The table uses the row level.

Racial spells are attributed to races from wowforevertalent.com and the Warcraft Tavern guide; the exact race list for Desperate Prayer, Fear Ward and Devouring Plague is not confirmed by the tooltips.
Vampiric Embrace: row 4 would open at level 25, but its tooltip says Requires level 30. The table uses the row level.
Penance (1240720) does not carry the Talent label on Wowhead (it is a trained-rank spell ID), although wowforevertalent.com lists the talent in Discipline row 5.
gaps: Every rank after the first and the level it is trained at.
Priest pets: none. Shadowfiend does not appear in the sources checked.

Racial spells of Night Elf, Human, Dwarf, Undead, Troll and Gnome were checked only against the two fan sites; the Classic spells Symbol of Hope, Lightwell, Pain Suppression and Binding Heal are not in Forever as far as the sources show.
Passive talents other than the four listed, and Classic spells that returned nothing on the tooltip API (Chastise 44041).
